events.anchor: A cooler city starts at street level
events.draft: Short draft held for the source visit.

samples.text: Start with shade: what parts of a street, pavement, or building does a tree shelter during the hottest hours? Then examine how water moves through the tree and its surroundings. These are related questions, but they call for different observations. A cool-looking surface and a more comfortable walk are not the same measurement.1
